Pricing questions

The details teams ask first.

Want to talk through your setup? Contact us.

How is OrgVia priced?

OrgVia has proposed introductory plans for new customers. Final pricing, tax and availability are confirmed during onboarding.

What happens if we add more employees?

Starter, Growth and Business plans have a monthly additional-employee rate. The calculator shows a monthly estimate only; annual additional-seat terms are confirmed in your quotation.

Can we change our plan?

Talk to the OrgVia team about changes to your commercial setup and enabled modules.

Is annual billing available?

Yes. Annual plan prices are shown for Starter, Growth and Business and are billed annually.

Does OrgVia offer a demo?

Yes. You can request a tailored product demonstration before making any commercial decision.

Which features are included?

The comparison below shows proposed plan entitlements. Payroll availability and other configuration details are confirmed in writing during onboarding.

What happens when our subscription expires?

Subscription renewal and expiry terms are confirmed in your commercial agreement.
